opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations working with disability, funding capital projects for new build, refurbishment or equipment, focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Provides grants to charities working in mental health for capital projects such as new build, refurbishment or equipment, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations providing care for older people, funding capital projects for new build, refurbishment or equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations managing historic sites of outstanding significance, funding conservation, restoration, interpretation and education spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS; UK only
opportunities.summary: Provides grants for new buildings, refurbishment, and equipment to improve care for patients and families in hospices and palliative care organisations.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports libraries and archives with nationally significant collections, funding new build, refurbishment, and equipment to improve public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Provides grants for museums and galleries to fund new build, refurbishment, and equipment, enhancing public access and engagement with collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports performing arts organisations to improve training and education facilities through new build, refurbishment, or specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university; UK only
opportunities.summary: Funds organisations with scientific or natural history collections to improve public engagement with science through new or refurbished galleries and education spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports high‑achieving state schools to improve specialist teaching spaces and equipment for subjects such as science, design & technology, art, languages, music and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority; UK only
opportunities.summary: Supports special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, funding new build, refurbishment or equipment to develop skills for employment or independent living.

opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Universities and research institutions; UK only
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for research‑intensive universities and institutions for new buildings, refurbishment, or major equipment to improve research infrastructure.
